hook: Fujita's very ampleness conjecture is proved for projective bundles over curves
summary: For a projective bundle over a smooth complex curve, the paper proves that the canonical bundle twisted by k ample line bundles is very ample once k is at least n+2. This settles a case of Fujita's very ampleness conjecture. It applies only to this class of bundles over curves, not to general varieties.
title: Fujita's Very Ampleness Conjecture for $\mathbb{P}^{n-1}$-Bundles over Curves
